special_rules.name: Allegiance: Iron Warriors
special_rules.text:
All units with the Iron Warriors Keyword gain the Allegiance: Iron Warriors special rule. The Allegiance: Iron Warriors special rule consists of the following rules:

- Iron Within, Iron Without:
    - All Iron Warriors units gain the Tank Hunter special rule.
    - All Fortification type units in your army gain a 5+ Invulnerable save.
- Abhor Mutation:
    - Iron Warriors may never select a unit to receive a Chaos Boon.
    - Iron Warriors units may not purchase any Marks of Chaos unless they have the Psyker (x) special rule.
    - When engaging Imperial Fists, you must play 1 additional Battle Round of the Game, regardless of the Battlepack rules.

special_rules.name: Armoury of the 4th Legion
special_rules.text:
Units with Allegiance: Iron Warriors have access to additional wargear presented in this supplement in addition to the war gear presented in the core Codex Chaos Space Marines.

Chaos Lord Upgrades

An Iron Warriors Chaos Lord may purchase the following upgrade in addition to the others available:

- Warsmith for 35pts.
- Daemonsmith for 40pts.

Wargear

Any Iron Warriors 'Legionnaire' or 'Aspiring Champion' model in a Legionnaire Squad unit may:

- Take a Boarding Shield for 3pts per model.

Any Iron Warriors unit with the Character special rule may:

- Take Enhanced Bionics for 10pts.
- Take Techno-Venomous Mechatendrils for 5pts.
- Take a Nest of Mechaserpents for 10pts.

Weapons

Any Iron Warriors Chaos Lord or Chaos Champion model may:

- Exchange their equipped Power Maul for a Graviton Mace for 2pts.

Any Iron Warriors 'Chosen' or 'Aspiring Champion' model in a Chosen unit may:

- Exchange their Close Combat Weapon for a Siege Breaker Mace for 20pts.

All Iron Warriors models in a unit may:

- Exchange their Bolt Pistol for a Shrapnel Pistol for 2pts per model.
- Exchange their Boltgun for a Shrapnel Boltgun for 2pts model.
- Exchange their Linked Boltgun or Combi-Bolter for a Linked Shrapnel Boltgun for 2pts per model.
- Exchange their Heavy Bolter for a Shrapnel Cannon for 2pts per model.
- Exchange their Linked Heavy Bolter for a Linked Shrapnel Cannon for 2pts per model.

special_rules.name: Calculated Victory
special_rules.text: If this unit is your Warlord, once per game, you may return 1 slain Inductii unit that was destroyed earlier battle to the field as a summoned unit. This unit enters play via the Outflank special rule but must be placed within your deployment zone.

special_rules.name: Daemonsmith
special_rules.text: A Chaos Lord with this upgrade may not take a Jump Pack. The Chaos Lord exchanges their Chainsword for a Graviton Mace and a Servo Arm. In addition, the Chaos Lord gains the Battle Smith (1) special rule. Further, the Chaos Lord can target Daemon Engine units with the Rite of Repair, Healing 1 Wound with each use.

special_rules.name: Field Piece
special_rules.text: This unit may only embark on the Centaur Light Carrier and may only do so if the unit size is 1 model.

special_rules.name: Garrison
special_rules.text: This model can garrison up to 22 Infantry models embarked within it. Models embarked within this Fortification may shoot in the shooting phase as normal, drawing all visibility and range from this unit's hull.

special_rules.name: Garrison
special_rules.text: This model can garrison up to 42 Infantry models embarked within it. Models embarked within this Fortification may shoot in the shooting phase as normal, drawing all visibility and range from this unit's hull.

special_rules.name: Grand Tyrant
special_rules.text: This unit and any attached unit may re-roll 1 dice when making a Pinning Test in the Shooting Phase.

special_rules.name: Hybrid Heritage
special_rules.text: If this unit is your Warlord, they gain the Siege Attacker special rule. In addition, this unit can re-roll all to hit rolls of 1 with its Shrapnel Pistol. This unit also gains the Hatred (Imperial Fists) special rule.

special_rules.name: Icarus Defences
special_rules.text: Any Linked Autocannon or Linked Lascannon that the Bastion is equipped with gains the Skyfire special rule.

special_rules.name: Shon'tu Lives!
special_rules.text: The first time this unit would be slain and removed from play, it is not. Instead, the unit remains on the Battlefield with all of its Wounds remaining.

special_rules.name: Warsmith
special_rules.text:
A Chaos Lord with this upgrade may not take a Jump Pack. The Chaos Lord exchanges their Chainsword for a Siege Breaker Mace and Servo Arm. In addition, the Chaos Lord and any attached unit gain the Siege Attacker special rule.

- The Warsmith may exchange its Siege Breaker Mace for a Chainfist for 0pts.
